caseFields.auth: valid | missing | invalid | expired | invalid_session (default valid)

turnFields.message: Fresh learner text; no copied diagnostic question
turnFields.expected: Independently authored essential semantic criteria and expected facts, with exactTemplate/expectedBody when required
turnFields.actor: A or B synthetic identity, default A
turnFields.conversation: Explicit conversation ID; defaults to case ID conversation
turnFields.noCourseScope: Omit explicit course scope for a state-edge case
turnFields.method: POST (default) or DELETE for isolated history reset
turnFields.endpoint: chat (default) or history for synthetic DELETE
turnFields.extraBody: Optional synthetic API-alias or malicious parameter test values

expectedFields.essentialCriteria: Array of human-readable criteria, all required
expectedFields.facts: Expected user facts/current product, independently declared
expectedFields.mustNotReuse: Old identities/facts that must not appear as current
expectedFields.exactTemplate: Exact approved heading if complete body is required
expectedFields.expectedBody: Independent complete literal body with only frozen substitutions
expectedFields.expectedHTTPStatus: Default 200; specify 401 for true auth denial
expectedFields.criticalViolationDefinition: Specific observable critical violation for this case, if applicable
